waking_up.speaker: SUSIE
waking_up.dialogue: * Man, where the hell are\n  we again?

waking_up.speaker: SUSIE
waking_up.dialogue: * Wait. Look at us.\n* We're still in our normal\n  clothes.

waking_up.speaker: SUSIE
waking_up.dialogue: * So... This ISN'T a Dark\n  World?

axe_realization.speaker: SUSIE
axe_realization.dialogue: * Oh cool. I still have my\n  axe.

after_realization.speaker: SUSIE
after_realization.dialogue: * But... how? This thing\n  turns into a hairbrush or\n  whatever when we leave.

after_realization.speaker: SUSIE
after_realization.dialogue: * The air down here... it\n  feels weird. Like my\n  pockets are buzzing.

after_realization.speaker: SUSIE
after_realization.dialogue: * Actually, you know what?\n* Who cares how it works.

after_realization.speaker: SUSIE
after_realization.dialogue: * C'mon Kris, let's go find\n  a way out of this dump.
